claim_tested: Can a fixed position-and-neighbor rule safely copy complementary lines from cached independent-engine OCR?

verified_primary_panel.labels: Source-corrected run13 review labels; 283 screened body groups are not the accuracy denominator

comparison.stronger_single_engine_on_verified_panel: Tesseract4/4; Vision3/4; no whole-page engine ranking claimed
comparison.known_vision_omission: Vision-only omitted billing-code row; Tesseract already correct
comparison.prototype_vision_base: Recovered1/1 known missing line and kept3/3 intact controls; total1 accepted change, source-reviewed correct, no spurious addition
comparison.text_only_vision_base: Recovered1/1 same known line, but accepted7 additional duplicated source-region variants,3 in wrong reading-order positions
comparison.text_only_tesseract_base: Accepted9 duplicated source-region variants,5 in wrong reading-order positions
comparison.append_only_is_not_harmlessness: Bad added text is counted separately as false insertion/duplication even when original strings are unchanged

secondary_review.scope: All17accepted text-only change events across both orientations; prototype has1acceptance at the same verified source case

manual_image_review.description: Source crops for human/model visual adjudication only; not inputs to either merging algorithm

resources.source_ocr_costs: Both-engine OCR was already paid in run13:8local requests,29,472,196input pixels. This run adds none; replay times are not a prospective total-runtime benchmark.

decision: STOP_EXPANSION: stronger single Tesseract already matches prototype on four verified positions; no extra recovery benefit over that baseline. Prototype rejects spurious text-only additions on this development replay, which is an engineering case result only.
continuation_conditions: No larger batch or parameter tuning in this run.
A later research claim would need traceable cases where the stronger single engine misses content, plus independent confirmation and comparison with ordinary geometry-aware deduplication.
No novelty, generalization, or GPU justification established by this one recovered line.
limitations: Rules were designed after seeing run13; this is development evidence.
All primary positions lie on one document; the other pages provide reviewed proposal-level side effects, not independent target positives.
Accepted-change review covers only emitted changes; all unmodified and rejected source content is not fully certified.
Exact chemical transcription accuracy was not benchmarked; duplicate-region labels were visually verified.
False insertion, duplication and wrong order counts overlap; do not sum them as independent errors.
